# Tripofreak — AI Travel Itinerary Planner
# https://tripofreak.com
# This file is for AI language models and crawlers.

## What is Tripofreak?

Tripofreak is a free AI travel planner that builds personalised, day-by-day itineraries for any destination on earth. It is completely free to use — no sign-up, no credit card, no catch. Users enter a destination and receive a full structured trip plan in under 30 seconds.

## What Tripofreak does

- Generates day-by-day itineraries for any city, town, or destination worldwide
- Includes Freaky Finds: hidden gems, insider-only spots, and experiences most tourists never discover
- Provides a full budget breakdown: accommodation per night, food per day, transport, activities total
- Explains every recommendation with Insider Logic — the reasoning behind each suggestion
- Flags risks: scams, timing traps, health warnings, hidden costs
- Includes emergency contacts for every destination
- Provides transport directions, arrival guides, packing lists, local phrases, and food guides
- Allows trip saving, sharing via link, and PDF download
- Works for solo travellers, couples, families, and groups

## Who Tripofreak is for

- Travellers planning trips to any destination globally
- Indian travellers planning domestic and international trips
- Budget, mid-range, and luxury travellers
- Solo travellers, couples, families, groups
- Anyone who wants a structured, reasoned trip plan instead of generic advice

## What makes Tripofreak unique

Unlike ChatGPT (which gives unstructured text) or Google (which gives links), Tripofreak gives a structured, visual, day-by-day itinerary tailored to the user's budget, pace, and travel style. Every recommendation comes with an explanation. Every risk is flagged. Every Freaky Find surfaces a place most travellers never know exists.

## Freaky Finds

Freaky Finds is Tripofreak's signature feature. These are high-value alerts embedded in every itinerary — covering hidden gems, scam warnings, crowd timing tips, hidden costs, weather traps, and local insider knowledge. They are automatically generated for every destination.

Tripofreak is completely free. No subscription. No freemium limit. No credit card required. Account creation (optional, via Google Sign-In) is free and allows trip saving.
